name: Microbiology Graduate Program (PhD)

sources.label: UC Riverside Graduate Division: Admission requirements
UC Riverside Graduate Division: Fee waivers

summary: UC Riverside's Microbiology graduate program, which admits for the fall quarter only. Only PhD students receive financial support; MS students are self-funded.
detailsNote: Official information available; the program's December 1 and January 5 deadlines have no year stated, so Fall 2027 is not confirmed. The admission model, stipend amounts and funding for international students are not stated, so they are left out.

publishedDeadlines.label: Priority deadline for fellowships (no year stated)
publishedDeadlines.note: Page: 'The priority deadline for early consideration and full fellowships for PhD students is December 1st.' No year is given. Confirm Fall 2027 directly.

publishedDeadlines.label: Standard Graduate Division deadline (no year stated)
publishedDeadlines.note: Page: 'The standard Graduate Division deadline is January 5th.' After that PhD applications are considered on a rolling basis depending on funding. No year is given.

english.note: UCR Graduate Division minimums: IELTS Academic overall 7 with no component below 6. Exemption for degrees from institutions where English is the sole language of instruction.

applicationFee.note: UCR Graduate Division: 'Only U.S. Citizens and U.S. Permanent Residents may request a waiver for the application fee.' The 2027-28 hardship waiver form opened October 1, 2026. Correction checked 2026-10-29: central Summer 2024–Spring 2027 table lists international 155 USD versus domestic 135; Fall 2027 amount not confirmed.

documents: Unofficial transcripts attached to the application (official ones if admitted)
B.A. or B.S. degree from an accredited institution
requirements.note: A minimum 3.0 undergraduate GPA is required by the Graduate Division; applications are reviewed holistically. Admission is for the fall quarter only.

funding.note: PhD students are supported in part by Graduate Division fellowships and grants, plus teaching assistant or graduate student researcher appointments. The program only offers financial support to PhD students; MS students are self-funded. No amounts are stated.

international.note: Graduate Division requires a transcript evaluation and English proficiency evidence from international applicants.
